records.text: Archaedas is an Ancient Stone Watcher who defends the Disks for the Makers. When awakened, he challenges the intruder and calls on fellow guardians to defend them; he treats the disturbance as an affront to the Makers and calls the attacker reckless.

Hammertoe Grez is a dwarf who was investigating the origins of his people and the titan excavations while trying to stop the Shadowforge clan from using scrolls to make stronger golems. Wounded and held in Uldaman, he asks for his amulet to be recovered; he wants it brought to Prospector Ryedol, who knows of his research and mission.

Magregan Deepshadow is identified by the wounded Hammertoe Grez as the dwarf holding Hammertoe's amulet. Hammertoe fears the amulet could lead the Shadowforge to scrolls for making stronger golems. Magregan's combat behavior includes casting Whirlwind.
A Shadowforge ruffian, this hostile humanoid fights with Kick and may flee for assistance when badly wounded.
A Shadowforge digger, this hostile humanoid uses Sunder Armor in combat.
The Shadowforge Relic Hunter is a combatant associated by title with relic hunting. Its combat ability includes Shadow Word: Pain.
The Shadowforge Darkcaster is a combatant whose spell is Shadow Bolt Volley.
The Shadowforge Archaeologist is presented as an archaeological role and fights with Defensive Stance and Disarm.
The Stonevault Cave Lurker is a cave-dwelling ambusher by title; its behavior includes using Sneak while out of combat.
The Stonevault Rockchewer is a Stonevault creature whose behavior includes entering a frenzy when badly wounded.
A Stonevault Oracle encountered in Uldaman.
A Stonevault Geomancer in Uldaman who uses fire magic in combat.
Grimlok is the Stonevault chieftain, a trogg leader who calls himself king. A translated journal says he has claimed the sapphire hidden in Uldaman.
A Stonevault Brawler in Uldaman whose fighting style can turn frenzied.
A Stonevault Cave Hunter is a humanoid combatant that can throw at an opponent in combat.
A Stone Keeper encountered in Uldaman, an elemental.
The Stone Steward is a stone elemental. It uses Ground Tremor in combat.
The Shrike Bat is a bat. In combat, it attacks with Sonic Burst.
The Jadespine Basilisk is a basilisk. In combat, it can cast Reflection and Crystalline Slumber.
An Obsidian Golem is a mechanical golem found in Loch Modan.

Baelog is trapped with his band at the dig site and relies on his journal to guide an explorer to the hidden Chamber of Khaz'mul; he knows how to open its huge locked door. His recorded response when found mixes relief with a joke about his bet with Olaf, who wagered that his beard would reach his knees before Baelog saw another living traveler.
Eric “The Swift” is a humanoid who can cast Rushing Charge in combat.
Olaf is the person Baelog names as his wager partner: Olaf bet that his beard would reach his knees before Baelog saw another living traveler.
Revelosh is a solitary named figure at the Uldaman dig site. In combat, he uses Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
Earthen Rocksmasher is an earthen combatant found in groups around the Uldaman dig site. It uses Battle Stance and Strike in combat.
Earthen Sculptor is an earthen combatant found around the Uldaman dig site. In combat, it uses Fire Shield and Flame Buffet.
Venomlash Scorpid is a venomous scorpion found near the Uldaman dig site. It attacks with Venom Sting.
Obsidian Sentinel is a lone mechanical guardian at the Uldaman dig site. It uses Reflection when engaged in combat.
A Shadowforge Geologist is an armed worker among the Blackrock dwarves of the Shadowforge. In a fight, it can strike with Flame Spike and Flame Lash.
Digmaster Shovelphlange has a role overseeing excavation.
An Earthen Guardian is one of the earthen beings in the Shadowforge. It can be drawn into combat with nearby threats, serving as a forceful defender rather than a guide or vendor.
An Earthen Hallshaper is an earthen being found among the Shadowforge. It fights with Reconstruct, a spell that suggests it can repair itself amid battle.
The Cleft Scorpid is a scorpion found in the Shadowforge.
A Stonevault Ambusher attacks by getting behind its target and striking with Backstab. When it goes into a frenzy, it announces the change with a battle cry.
The Ancient Stone Keeper is a solitary stone creature in the Shadowforge. In combat it unleashes Sand Storm; when summoned, it moves about at random.
Ironaya is a stone guardian of the Makers’ secrets. In combat she warns that no one may steal those secrets, then attacks with Arcing Smash and Knock Away.
A Shadowforge sharpshooter, this dwarf serves in combat with a ranged attack.
Galgann Firehammer is a dwarf who calls on Thaurissan as he orders his foes slain. In battle he uses Amplify Flames and Fire Nova.
Earthen Custodians are stone creatures that can be compelled into combat with nearby foes. They can cast Stoned.
Stonevault Maulers are dwarves that use Thrash and can enter a frenzy.
Stonevault Flameweavers are dwarves who use fire magic in combat, including Immolate and Inferno Shell.
Earthen Stonebreaker is an earthen creature that uses Battle Stance and Strike.
Earthen Stonecarver is an earthen creature that uses Fire Shield IV and Flame Buffet.
A Deadly Cleft Scorpid is a scorpid creature associated with the Cleft.
Vault Warder is a stone dwarf creature that uses Stoned and Trample. A spell hit can trigger its awakening visual and removal of the Stoned aura.

Annora is an enchanting trainer who teaches the profession. In one conditional greeting, she thanks a traveler for dealing with dreadful creatures and says she had feared she might have to hide indefinitely.

place_records.text: You are in Uldaman, the ruin of the Makers, reached from Dustwind Gulch in the Badlands. Shadowforge dwarves and Stonevault troggs vie for control of the dig site, and Grimlok, the Stonevault chieftain, calls himself king. Archaedas, an Ancient Stone Watcher, defends the Disks for the Makers. Baelog and his band are trapped at the dig site, and Hammertoe Grez lies wounded here, still asking for his amulet. Earthen custodians fill the place.
